<!--
Research notes, Hy-Point Software.

Surfaced while building out SDIF, as the publisher of the only product in the held
periodicals that advertised compliance with the published interchange standard as a selling
point.

Do not confuse with Hy-Tek. The names differ by three letters, both companies published
swimming meet-management software in the same era, and both product names contain "Meet
Manager". They are unrelated as far as anything found here shows, and a grep of the
periodicals for either name returns the other. The Hy-Tek pages and this one should not be
cross-contaminated.

Everything known comes from one display advertisement for SwimMeet Manager, printed
repeatedly: Swimming World September 2000 to February 2001 and Swimming Technique October
2000 and January 2001. Contact details given there are hy-point.com, info@hy-point.com and
telephone (219) 922-4634. The 219 area code covers northwest Indiana, which is the only
geographic indication found; no street address was printed, so the company is placed no
more precisely than that and the infobox carries no headquarters row rather than a guess.

Verified: the advertisement, its run, and the contact details as printed. Not verified: when
the company was founded, who ran it, how large it was, whether it published anything besides
SwimMeet Manager, and when and why it stopped. No editorial mention, review or
buyer's-guide entry was found in the held periodicals. The domain was not fetched on this
pass and is assumed lapsed rather than confirmed lapsed.

Note on scope. This is a software publisher, not a manufacturer, so the vendor page skeleton
in STYLE.md section 4.4 fits only loosely; its lead form assumes a manufacturer of hardware.
Build it out along the lines of the other software-company pages rather than the equipment
vendors.

Still to research: the company's history and fate, any other products, and whether the
SwimMeet Manager compliance claim can be tested against a surviving file.
-->

This article is a stub. Hy-Point Software was an American publisher of swimming
meet-management software, known chiefly from advertisements for its
[SwimMeet Manager](../software/swimmeet-manager.md) program in the swimming press between
2000 and 2001, which gave a northwest Indiana telephone number and no street address.

It is a different company from [Hy-Tek](hy-tek.md), whose product names it closely
resembles; see the [vendors index](index.md) for the companies this section covers.
